mapper.update: UPDATE destination_comment_images i JOIN destination_comments c ON c.id = i.comment_id SET i.gallery_status = 'REVOKED', i.gallery_consent_withdrawn_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND i.gallery_status IN ('PENDING', 'APPROVED', 'REJECTED')
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, status, db_completed_at, completed_at, created_at, updated_at FROM account_purge_jobs WHERE user_id = #{userId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO account_purge_tasks (purge_job_id, task_type, provider, target_value, status, attempts) VALUES (#{purgeJobId}, #{taskType}, #{provider}, #{targetValue}, #{status}, #{attempts})
mapper.select: SELECT id, purge_job_id, task_type, provider, target_value, status, attempts, next_retry_at, last_attempt_at, completed_at, last_error, created_at, updated_at FROM account_purge_tasks WHERE purge_job_id = #{purgeJobId} ORDER BY id
mapper.sql: id, purge_job_id, task_type, provider, target_value, status, attempts, next_retry_at, last_attempt_at, completed_at, last_error, created_at, updated_at
mapper.update: UPDATE account_purge_tasks SET status = 'COMPLETED', completed_at = #{completedAt}, next_retry_at = NULL, last_error = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT d.cover_image_url AS image_url FROM diaries d WHERE d.user_id = #{userId} AND d.cover_image_url IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT e.image_url FROM diary_elements e JOIN diary_pages p ON p.id = e.page_id JOIN diaries d ON d.id = p.diary_id WHERE d.user_id = #{userId} AND e.element_type = 'PHOTO' AND e.image_url IS NOT NULL UNION -- 다이어리에 적용된 표지의 사진. 보관함 원본과 다른 복사본이라 따로 지워야 한다. -- (라이브러리에서 받은 사진은 image_url 이 비어 있어 여기에 들어오지 않는다) SELECT e.image_url FROM diary_cover_elements e JOIN diary_covers c ON c.id = e.cover_id JOIN diaries d ON d.id = c.diary_id WHERE d.user_id = #{userId} AND e.element_type = 'PHOTO' AND e.image_url IS NOT NULL
SELECT DISTINCT e.image_url FROM diary_cover_design_elements e JOIN diary_cover_designs c ON c.id = e.design_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND e.element_type = 'PHOTO' AND e.image_url IS NOT NULL
